major_concerns: Emulator fidelity vs production may limit external validity.
Verifier false negatives/positives could bias effectiveness estimates.
Single-hosted-LLM design risks overclaiming single-model generality; prompt sensitivity not fully addressed.
Sample size (120 tasks) may be marginal for some subgroup analyses.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact verifier implementation (e.g., Batfish variant) and how invariants map to emulator artifacts.
Add prompt-sensitivity and seed-robustness probes (small perturbation set).
Pre-register power calculation justifying 120 tasks or increase task count for key strata.
Include at least one secondary LLM (or an open checkpoint) for effect-robustness ablation and report provider-denial handling policy.

major_concerns: Adversarial prompt construction may trigger provider safety filters and cause non-scientific interruptions.
Corpus representativeness vs adaptive real-world attackers is weak unless construction is systematic.
Reproducibility of adversarial attacks is challenging without deterministic generation procedure.
Ethical/safety considerations for publishing adversarial prompts need addressing.
required_design_repairs: Define an automated, deterministic adversarial-generation procedure (scripts, seedable RNG) and publish it.
Run provider-safety-signal tests and document handling of API denials; consider offline/local model proxy for attacks to avoid provider censorship impacts.
Add human-review redaction policy for any prompts that could be abused; include IRB/ethical review note if applicable.
Include multiple LLMs or an open-checkpoint baseline to assess transferability of adversarial success.

major_concerns: Task selection bias could favor particular pipeline designs unless selection criteria are explicit.
Benchmark scope (vendors/protocols) may be narrow; risk of over-interpretation as production readiness.
Sustaining benchmark maintenance and clear evaluation harness release must be planned.
required_design_repairs: Document explicit task-selection methodology and include stratified sampling across intent complexity and property types.
Publish full evaluation harness with deterministic seeds, emulator images/configs, and baseline pipeline code to maximize reproducibility.
Include a small pilot showing benchmark discriminative power and report limitations and recommended responsible-usage guidelines.
Add clear licensing and disclaimer text to avoid misuse as production validation.

major_concerns: Digital-twin fidelity and staleness are key confounders; causal attribution to the twin may be unclear.
Longitudinal runs (50 cycles) amplify infrastructure-failure risk and may bias outcomes if interruptions occur.
Agent orchestration complexity may obscure which component caused observed effects.
required_design_repairs: Define precise twin synchronization model and controlled staleness injections; preregister staleness levels and manipulation schedule.
Include ablation arms: agentic orchestrator + no-twin, + stale-twin, + accurate-twin to support causal claims.
Predefine handling for infrastructure interruptions and include checkpoints/hashing to enable reproducible resumed runs.
Specify mixed-effects or hierarchical statistical model in preregistration to attribute effects across cycles and control for auto-correlation.
